name: Ruin Reading
description: Read the marks a laid net leaves in the souls it has caught to learn how each is faring.

name: Hidden Knot
description: Knot soul force inside a target's soul where it cannot see it and draw the knot tight on command.

name: Ruinous Guard
description: Gird the self in layers of soul force so thick that mental blows lose their edge.

name: Dragging Weft
description: Drag a heavy weft of soul force across a group so every soul in it labours under great weight.

name: Stricken Net
description: Fasten a net of soul force into several souls at once so each is trapped in the same instant.

name: Corroding Gin
description: Plant a gin of soul force that sours the soul it closes on and spreads the souring to souls near it.

name: Withering Lattice
description: Hold a lattice of soul force that saps the strength of every soul inside it with each breath.

name: Rending Barb
description: Drive a heavy barb of soul force through every layer of a soul's guard in one thrust.

name: Pitiless Cage
description: Close a cage of soul force that tightens with every move its captives make.

name: Soul Harrow
description: Drag a harrow of soul force across a held soul until its will is torn to furrows.

name: Unmaking Cinch
description: Cinch a target's soul so hard that every technique inside it is sealed shut at once.

name: Hollowing Net
description: Cast a net of soul force over all souls in range that draws their strength out through its strands.

name: Annihilating Gaol
description: Cast a cage of soul force at the destructive ceiling of its tier that crushes every soul inside to ruin.
